recent: ISF Group 近期获得价值 RM83.2m 的 Port Dickson 超大规模数据中心合约，令订单簿增至 RM225.5m；同时公布 2026 财年第三季业绩，净利按年增长 83.3% 至 RM9.2m。此外，公司董事及大股东于 9 月 23 日间接减持股份。
notable: 获得价值 RM83.2m 的 Port Dickson 超大规模数据中心合约，订单簿增至 RM225.5m。

risks: 董事及大股东于 2026 年 9 月 23 日间接减持 2.59% 股份。

recent_en: ISF Group recently secured RM83.2m worth of hyperscale data centre contracts in Port Dickson, lifting its order book to RM225.5m. It also reported Q3 2026 net profit up 83.3% year-on-year to RM9.2m. Separately, directors and a substantial shareholder indirectly disposed of shares on 23 September.
notable_en: Secured RM83.2m hyperscale data centre contracts in Port Dickson, raising order book to RM225.5m.
Q3 2026 net profit rose 83.3% year-on-year to RM9.2m.
Directors and a substantial shareholder indirectly disposed of 25,900,000 ordinary shares (2.59%) on 23 September 2026.
risks_en: Directors and a substantial shareholder indirectly disposed of a 2.59% stake on 23 September 2026.
earnings_en: For Q3 FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was RM31.385m, up 19.9% QoQ; net income was RM8.168m, up 89.2% QoQ; net margin rose from 16.5% to 26.0%.
